Stratified Newcombe Hybrid Score CI for a difference of two proportions

Source: R/newcombes_hs.r
ks_newcombe_hs_strata.Rd

Extends Newcombe's Hybrid Score method to stratified data using Mantel-Haenszel harmonic-mean weights. Within each stratum the Wilson score intervals are computed for both groups; the stratum-level contributions are then pooled via weighted combination to produce a single CI for the overall difference.

Usage

ks_newcombe_hs_strata(x1, n1, x2, n2, alpha = 0.05)

Arguments

x1

Integer vector of event counts for group 1, one element per stratum.

n1

Integer vector of sample sizes for group 1, one element per stratum (\(> 0\)).

x2

Integer vector of event counts for group 2, one element per stratum.

n2

Integer vector of sample sizes for group 2, one element per stratum (\(> 0\)).

alpha

Significance level; scalar in \((0,1)\). Defaults to 0.05 (95% CI).

Value

A named numeric vector of length 3:

delta

Weighted pooled point estimate.

lcl

Lower confidence limit.

ucl

Upper confidence limit.

Details

Algorithm:

  1. Compute Wilson CIs \([l_{1i},\,u_{1i}]\) and \([l_{2i},\,u_{2i}]\) for each stratum \(i\).

  2. Assign stratum weights \(W_i = n_{1i}\,n_{2i} / (n_{1i} + n_{2i})\) (harmonic-mean / Mantel-Haenszel weights).

  3. Pooled point estimate: \(\hat\delta = \sum W_i (p_{1i}-p_{2i}) / \sum W_i\).

  4. Pooled lower limit: $$\mathrm{LCL} = \hat\delta - \sqrt{\frac{\sum W_i^2(p_{1i}-l_{1i})^2}{(\sum W_i)^2} + \frac{\sum W_i^2(u_{2i}-p_{2i})^2}{(\sum W_i)^2}}$$

  5. Pooled upper limit: analogously.

A single stratum reduces to the un-stratified formula.

References

Newcombe, R. G. (1998). Interval estimation for the difference between independent proportions: comparison of eleven methods. Statistics in Medicine, 17(8), 873–890. doi:10.1002/(SICI)1097-0258(19980430)17:8<873::AID-SIM779>3.0.CO;2-I

See also

ks_newcombe_hs

Examples

## Two-stratum example
ks_newcombe_hs_strata(
  x1 = c(36L, 10L), n1 = c(54L, 30L),
  x2 = c(41L,  8L), n2 = c(56L, 30L)
)
#>       delta         lcl         ucl 
#> -0.01882756 -0.15251739  0.11513790 

## Single stratum — identical to ks_newcombe_hs()
ks_newcombe_hs_strata(36L, 54L, 41L, 56L)
#>       delta         lcl         ucl 
#> -0.06547619 -0.23089667  0.10396319 
ks_newcombe_hs(36L, 54L, 41L, 56L)  # same result
#>            delta        lcl       ucl
#> [1,] -0.06547619 -0.2308967 0.1039632
